page.overview:
Who is Judgement Girls?

The are a group of young women who first appear in the Street Fighter III games. They are the female judges who decide the winner after a draw occurs at the end of a round. Some of the Judgement Girls also appear in the Kanzuki Beach DLC stage from Street Fighter V, while Fair Libra appears as an NPC in the World Tour of Street Fighter 6.

In Street Fighter 6, she can be fought in the Fighty Mighty side-mission.
